title: Why Your Brain Feels Exhausted All the Time
hooks: Your brain is tired, not your body.
This is why you feel exhausted even after resting.

scenes.text: You don’t feel tired because you did too much.
You feel tired because your brain never stops thinking.
Overthinking drains more energy than physical work.
Your nervous system stays in alert mode all day.
That’s why rest doesn’t feel refreshing anymore.
To recover, you must calm your mind, not just your body.
